name: megascenes-emoji
description: Create custom emoji as small square images, readable at chat size, for Slack, Discord and other messaging apps.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a face, an object or a reaction and get a custom emoji: a small square image that stays readable at chat size.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the emoji in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The emoji opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For team chats, community servers and streams.

Limitations: new images from a description; it does not upload emoji to Slack or Discord for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Keep them readable at chat size
Return the emoji in the chat
defaultPrompt: A party parrot wearing a tiny crown
A coffee cup with a sleepy face
A thumbs up made of pixel hearts

positive.prompt: A party parrot wearing a tiny crown, as an emoji. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one emoji needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A coffee cup with a sleepy face, as an emoji. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one emoji needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make an emoji here?
positive.expected_behavior: The emoji models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A thumbs up made of pixel hearts, as an emoji. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my emoji on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my emoji to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
